purpose: Initial-occupation preservation reconstruction, separate from official CSDI reference rendering

estateMarker.meaning: Publisher's estate locator marker, not a surveyed block corner or a replacement game origin

missingEvidence: Original exterior colours and materials at first occupation
Original windows, entrances, roof details and landscape
Surveyed footprint, orientation and height for each named block
Dated original site/floor plans and permitted reproduction terms
Stable mapping from each block to the runtime CSDI feature or mesh
Confirmed imagery acquisition date for the CSDI surfaces
conflicts: intakeYear means intake/occupation year; do not silently relabel it as a verified construction completion date
Current record image is empty and furtherInfo is '-'; this retrieval does not substantiate earlier claims that the page supplies floor/site plans
Published block order does not prove spatial ordering or block-letter assignments

useBoundary: Use verified metadata to identify the estate. Do not invent building dimensions, original finishes, or landmark placements. Preserve the existing CSDI world until block-specific evidence supports a separately labelled reconstruction.
